description: BI last-mile: finish GeoParquet export, add a BI-consumable egress (parquet/CSV download + DuckDB-attach, OData fast-follow), and a copy-paste UX that hands the user a SQL string / API URL / connection string to paste into PowerBI/spreadsheets. Plus the hardening the pivot forces: query cost limits, CRS correctness, RBAC-on-results.
wave_rationale: The single highest-leverage investment toward the PRIMARY roadmap goal (spatial analytics engine). Backbone exists (/api/v1/query, fe-query columnar/duckdb_compat); this is the last mile. Depends on hexon_scale_orchestration (CRS/scale) for trustworthy numbers and auth_policy (RBAC-on-results slice).

alignment.rationale: The killer feature — copy-paste query/URL into PowerBI. Everything else in the analytics push serves this.

notes: NEW track from the 2026-07-14 alignment pass. Egress shape decision: DuckDB-attach + parquet/CSV first (duckdb_compat exists), OData fast-follow. CRS conversion at API layer only (fe-query/src/AGENTS.md §local-coords). Reuse execute_query guards; add cost/row/timeout limits (roadmap §4.1). RBAC-on-results coordinates with auth_policy_pattern. PHASE 1 COMPLETE 2026-07-15 (FR-1): real GeoParquet writer/reader in fe-query columnar/geoparquet/{mod,codec}.rs behind new lighter `parquet` feature (arrow+parquet 54.x, WKB Point Z, CRS-honest `geo` metadata defaulting to PETAL-LOCAL:meters), 5 tests incl. round-trip; cargo check --features parquet green; Task 1.4 test sweep deferred to session-end integrated sweep. PHASE 4 TASKS 4.1+4.2 COMPLETE 2026-07-15 (FR-3): GIS panel Export tab 'Copy for BI' card (fe-ui/src/panels/egress_card.rs) + pure tested builders (fe-ui/src/gis/egress_strings.rs, 12 tests) — SQL (petal/node/bbox) / query+export URLs / DuckDB read_parquet snippet / mint-share curl, all per the Phase 2-3 plan contract; egui builtin clipboard, no new deps. Follow-up: wire an in-app fe-ui->fe-api HTTP mint call for POST /api/v1/query/share (no client seam exists; curl display shipped instead). Task 4.3 sweep deferred to session-end. PHASES 2+3+5 COMPLETE 2026-07-15 (FR-2/4/5/6 deltas): fe-api export.rs (GET /petals/:id/export.parquet|.csv?query=&coords=local|latlon, DuckDB-httpfs headers), query_guard.rs (guard pipeline extracted verbatim from execute_query, one shared entry point) + limits.rs (D4 constants; row-cap policy = error-not-truncate), share.rs (ed25519 verify_strict signed URL: POST /api/v1/query/share authed mint + public GET /api/v1/shared/{token} redemption with scope ceiling, 401/410), crs.rs (D3 three-branch resolution; /query envelope + CSV comment + parquet geo metadata all CRS-stamped; landmine test green). fe-query gained write_nodes_parquet_bytes shim. ~20 new tests (share unit, query_guard unit, crs unit, export_share_test.rs integration READ-BACK). ApiState.share_signer is per-process ephemeral — persistent key wiring in main.rs is an integration request (fe-api/AGENTS.md §share). Exports are node-table-only; parquet/csv share links require petal-scoped tokens. Tasks 2.5/3.3/5.3 sweeps deferred to session-end integrated sweep. Remaining: Phase 6 (e2e + docs + workspace sweep).
